camera_profile.camera_variation_policy: Production previews may orbit only in 90-degree yaw increments; gameplay readability must remain valid from the canonical view.

scale_profile.rule: Real-world-derived scale with modest silhouette exaggeration only where gameplay readability requires it.
scale_profile.gameplay_authority_note: Dimensions in art metadata are visual-production hints and do not override simulation or room-rule authority.

geometry_language.silhouette: Clean, readable, slightly simplified forms with recognizable hospitality-specific proportions.
geometry_language.edge_treatment: Small consistent bevels on exposed manufactured edges; avoid razor-sharp CG edges.
geometry_language.detail_density: Medium. Large forms read first, functional secondary detail second, microdetail last.
geometry_language.ornament: Controlled and context-specific; premium assets may use restrained classical or Art Deco cues without becoming fantasy.

material_response.roughness: Material identity must read primarily through roughness and value separation rather than texture noise.
material_response.metallic: Only physically plausible metal surfaces use metallic response.
material_response.normal_detail: Subtle; never strong enough to break readability at management-camera distance.
material_response.glass: Tinted lightly, readable edges, restrained reflections.

palette.rule: Use warm hospitality neutrals as the base. Saturated color is reserved for wayfinding, upholstery accents, uniforms, art, and focal décor.

lighting_profile.shadow: soft directional shadows with readable contact darkening
lighting_profile.rule: Do not bake dramatic cinematic contrast into assets; lighting must remain compatible with simulation-wide day/night variation.

character_profile.proportions: slightly stylized realistic adults, approximately 6.5-7 heads tall
character_profile.face: simple readable planes, low-frequency features, no uncanny photoreal skin
character_profile.uniforms: functional silhouettes with role recognition through cut, accessories, and restrained color coding

pivot_profile.rule: Pivots must support snapping, placement preview, and deterministic rotation.

interaction_anchor_profile.rule: Anchors describe presentation/animation approach points only; gameplay reachability remains simulation authority.
